bullets: • SBI ELSS Tax Advantage Fund carries an exit load of 0%, meaning no exit load fee is charged upon redemption, as the mandatory 3-year lock-in period itself restricts early withdrawals.
• The expense ratio for SBI Large Cap Fund Direct Plan typically ranges between 0.5% and 0.9% per annum, which is deducted from the fund's Net Asset Value (NAV).
• Regular plans of SBI Mutual Fund schemes carry a higher expense ratio compared to direct plans, primarily due to the inclusion of distributor commission in the cost structure.
• Securities Transaction Tax (STT) of 0.001% is applicable on equity mutual fund redemptions, which is a government-mandated tax collected at the time of redemption.
• SEBI mandates that all mutual fund schemes disclose their Total Expense Ratio (TER), ensuring transparency in the fees charged to investors across all SBI Mutual Fund schemes.
• Exit load structures and expense ratios may vary across different SBI Mutual Fund schemes, and investors should review the scheme information document (SID) for scheme-specific fee details.
